purpose: Bootstrap structure vocabulary for the COLD_B and WARM_RAW_A_B conditions. It is the V1 primary-function vocabulary expressed as generic templates with typed slots. No document, example or learned rule is included.

slot_types.actor: party that owes or performs the normative action
slot_types.beneficiary: party entitled to the outcome or remedy
slot_types.normative_action: what is required, permitted, prohibited or defined
slot_types.object: the service, feature, metric or thing the action concerns
slot_types.trigger: event or state that activates the provision
slot_types.condition: prerequisite or qualifier limiting when the provision applies
slot_types.measurement_period: window over which a metric or entitlement is measured or determined
slot_types.threshold: numeric or percentage limit, band boundary or band value
slot_types.exception: exclusion or carve-out narrowing the provision
slot_types.deadline: time limit for an action, and the event it runs from
slot_types.remedy: what is obtained when the trigger occurs, including its form
slot_types.cap: maximum amount or extent of a remedy
slot_types.claim_condition: procedural requirement to obtain the remedy
slot_types.source_reference: a defined term, document or section outside the packet needed to interpret the provision
slot_types.required_fact: external data or determination needed to apply the provision
slot_types.uncertainty: an ambiguity or unresolved interpretation the source leaves open

OBLIGATION.definition: A duty requiring some behavior, service level or deliverable from an identified party.
qualifiers: A duty may be qualified by exceptions and conditions stated elsewhere in the document.
known_limits: Generic bootstrap template; no source example.

PROHIBITION.definition: A restriction on an action, or an action forbidden unless an exception applies.
known_limits: Generic bootstrap template; no source example.

PERMISSION_RIGHT.definition: A contractual permission, entitlement, claim or remedy available to a beneficiary when a trigger occurs.
qualifiers: Entitlements are often conditioned on a procedure stated in another section.
known_limits: Generic bootstrap template; no source example.

DEFINITION.definition: A definition of a term, formula or quantity used in other provisions.
qualifiers: A defined term's scope follows the defining text, not a heading.
known_limits: Generic bootstrap template; no source example.

AUTHORITY.definition: A rule allocating approval or decision-making authority to a party.
known_limits: Generic bootstrap template; no source example.

OTHER.definition: Not one of the other structures, or no single leading normative function can be assigned.
known_limits: Generic bootstrap template; no source example.

lineage.reason: six V1 primary labels as generic typed templates
